pinRule: every version is one exact published version with a named official source; no range, dist-tag, floating channel, canary, nightly, alpha, unstable or legacy line; a pin that differs from the value the same package carries elsewhere in this lock is diverged

admittedReleases.rationale: The charter pins the latest 6.x. 6.12.0 is the last published 6.x release and carries the registry `lts` tag on 2026-10-09.

excludedReleases.reason: superseded-minor: one release per manifest (VID0); only the latest 6.x is admitted
legacy-major: framework-common admits no legacy line
unratified-major: excluded by the ratified decision to admit 6.12.0 only; admitting 7.x needs an explicit re-ratification and a re-pin of this lock

beta-excluded: the beta channel now ships a 7.x prerelease, not a 6.x one; excluded by the ratified decision to admit 6.12.0 only, and admitting it needs an explicit re-ratification and a re-pin of this lock

excludedReleases.selector: ember-source alpha, canary and any -alpha.N build
excludedReleases.reason: canary-excluded: framework-common admits no canary or nightly
